title: The Hedgerows

victory.note: The Germans win if they end the game in control of 1 hex of the largest stone building in columns U to EE. Otherwise the Americans win.

situation: Fields cut by hedges. The defenders hold a stone building at the east end. The Germans attack with 4 squads under 1 leader, 4 support weapons, and 2 armored vehicles. The Americans hold with 3 squads under 1 leader, 3 support weapons, and 1 armored vehicle. The Germans win if they end the game in control of 1 hex of the largest stone building in columns U to EE. Otherwise the Americans win. The Germans move first. 7 turns.
